1.9.summary: The wording changes marked by hand on the printed v1.7 copy, applied to every page, and a "Fall 2026" stamp in place of the version number.
bullets: Wording changes from the handwritten notes of 13 October are in on every page. They cover the folder insert, the flyer, the faculty sheet, the department cover, What You Do Here, Education and Coursework, More Than the Code, and the model programs.
The copy speaks to the reader as "you" throughout. It used to switch between "you" and "students".

Computer Science, Data Science, Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics and Mathematics are capitalized everywhere, and so are the topics in each professor's focus line on the faculty sheet.

The printed pages now carry "Fall 2026" where they carried the version number. The three model programs carry only "2026-27 catalog". The version number still names the files and this page, and the reviewer's copy still prints it.
Girls Who Code replaces Women in Computing on More Than the Code, in the club list and in the conferences paragraph.
Fernando Santos's origin line is off the faculty sheet, since no one else's was there.

On the Data Science model program the Ethics elective (PHIL 205 or BUS 392) moves from Senior Fall to Senior Spring, because PHIL 205 is offered in the spring only. It swaps places with a plain Elective, so every term keeps its hours and the total stays 124.

MATH 251 and MATH 252 are half-semester courses, one after the other, so MATH 252 now sits in Freshman Spring beside MATH 251 on the BCS and CS Plus model programs, as the catalog's sample schedule has it. Health and Movement 1 moves to Sophomore Spring to keep the two terms at 16 and 15 hours, and the total stays 124. The two courses had been split across two years on the mistaken reading that they cannot share a term.

On all three model programs, the half-semester courses say which half they run in: MATH 251, CS 375 and DATA 385 in the first half, MATH 252, CS 376 and DATA 304 in the second, and the legend explains it. Checked against the Spring 2027 sections in Workday.

DATA 202 prints under its Workday title, Predictive Analytics, on all three model programs. The Data Science program's six hours of business electives are now called "Business and Soft Skills elective", the department's own name for that list.

The reviewer's guide no longer lists the MATH 251/252 and Data Science elective questions, which are answered, and states the current prerequisite rule. It points to the bleed copies instead of saying there are none.

The department cover photograph is 12 pixels shorter and the Calvin Hackathon box has a "Fun fact" sub-bullet. Page 7's photograph is 20 pixels shorter and its opening paragraph is set at 15.5 pixels instead of 16, so the list under it is no longer covered by the picture.

The download page keeps only the current version and the one before it. Older versions have their own page at a separate address, which the main page links to. The tour card has its own section near the top of the page, with a link in the header, and the one-page card's link now opens the card instead of its bleed copy. The page's wording was read against the AI-writing rubric.

1.8.summary: The bleed copies for a commercial printer, corrected after the printer's review. The pages themselves are unchanged from v1.7.
bullets: The v1.7 bleed copies were wrong. The printer found white strips with a thin line down the middle, and a small colored box in each corner, where the color should have run off the page. The bands now carry the page's own color and photographs the full quarter inch past the edge, so a cut that wanders cannot show white.
The crop marks are gone. They sat inside the bleed, so they could show on a wandering cut and they printed on the blank backs.
Each bleed file records the finished 8.5 by 11 size inside it, so the printer's software knows where the cut goes and nothing is drawn on the sheet.

A new check, tools/check-bleed.py, reads the bleed itself and fails the build if a line of it is not a single color from the sheet edge to the trim. It catches both faults above, and a pale hairline along the right and bottom edges of the faculty sheet that the first fix still left.
Every page and filename reads v1.8. The office copier files are the v1.7 pages with the new stamp.
